propositions: A new LLM criterion no-file-impact must judge whether a ticket declaring file_impact_scope=none actually requires repository-file changes, running only when persisted scope is exactly none and skipping paths/undeclared/missing/None/unknown values.
The criterion applies deterministically via extends routing validator with require_file_impact_scope list membership predicate, passed ctx.state.get(file_impact_scope) at orchestrator call site.

Pass-1 must carry persisted no_file_impact_reason as deterministic JSON-serialized declared_reason block alongside any G5 context, in stable order, preserving exact strings including quotes/newlines/Unicode.

The criterion rubric produces assertion_plausible via three sub-answer fields: repo_file_change_named=yes or required-deliverable-edit maps to advisory contradiction; reason_grounded=yes AND repo_file_change_named=no maps to PASS; reason_grounded=no/insufficient maps to non-blocking coaching requesting stronger declared reason.
Persisted scope values paths/undeclared/missing/None/unknown must NOT select no-file-impact; scope=none MUST select it; existing criteria selection must remain identical across all scope inputs.

All acceptance criteria and held-out oracle test contracts verify public behavior at observable seams: routing config validation, criterion presence in canonical registry, Pass-1 request payload round-trip, CLI explain output, gate verdict aggregation, and generated-guide idempotence—never source-text assertions or private implementation details.
